en: Colorized vintage scene showing several men in Ottoman-era clothing sitting and standing among ancient stone blocks on a grassy slope overlooking a town. In the background are low houses with red roofs and, prominently, a round white building topped with a slender minaret, characteristic of an Ottoman mosque. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. A small website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom.
